descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S22 Existing spec: the billing call's log row carries the total and the AI provider's time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U16 Each billing call logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total, and which model answered (and whether it fell back to the backup); … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local backend without vendor credentials

When Call notes.suggestBilling among the six AI call kinds

Then diagnostics:list has a notes.suggestBilling row with a numeric providerMs and durationMs >= providerMs

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts. It does not check the model field (3.9 is read by S21)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S22

Existing spec: the billing call's log row carries the total and the AI provider's time

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-18.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts [api] — every kind of AI call item 7 names logs the vendor's time — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts): it signs in the local fixture user through e2e/support/backend.ts on a backend without vendor credentials; dev has no admin key and nothing may sign in there, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
